# Overview

This notebook computes the **Travel Ratio (TR)** from ChIP-seq data. TR measures the ratio of gene body signal to TSR (Transcription Start Region) signal, indicating transcriptional elongation efficiency.

**Key improvements in this refactored version:**

- Modular, reusable functions
- Configuration file support (YAML)
- Comprehensive error handling and validation
- Better documentation and logging
- Replaced bash/Python code with native R functions
- Improved plots and visualizations
- No hardcoded values

---

# Setup

## Load Required Libraries

```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Required packages
required_packages <- c("yaml", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "readr",
                       "stringr", "knitr", "DT")

# Install missing packages
missing_packages <- required_packages[!required_packages %in%
                                      installed.packages()[,"Package"]]
if(length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  message("Installing missing packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

# Load libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(yaml)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(knitr)
  library(DT)
})

# Set ggplot theme
theme_set(theme_minimal())
```

## Load Configuration

```{r config}
# Load configuration from YAML file
config_file <- "config.yaml"

if (!file.exists(config_file)) {
  stop("Configuration file not found: ", config_file,
       "\nPlease create config.yaml or update the path.")
}

config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_file)

# Display configuration
cat("Configuration loaded successfully!\n\n")
cat("Key parameters:\n")
cat(sprintf("  - Minimum gene length: %d bp\n",
            config$gene_filters$min_gene_length))
cat(sprintf("  - TSR region: -%d to +%d bp from TSS\n",
            config$tsr_parameters$upstream_extension,
            config$tsr_parameters$downstream_extension))
cat(sprintf("  - Signal cutoff: %.2f\n",
            config$transcript_selection$signal_cutoff))
cat(sprintf("  - Distance cutoff: %d bp\n",
            config$gene_filters$distance_cutoff))
```

## Source Core Functions

```{r source_functions}
# Source the main R script containing all functions
# This avoids code duplication
source("compute_travel_ratio.R")

cat("Core functions loaded successfully!\n")
```

---

# Pipeline Execution

## Step 1: Setup Output Directory

```{r setup_output}
output_dir <- config$output$output_dir

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Create subdirectories
subdirs <- c("bed_files", "signals", "plots", "logs")
for (subdir in subdirs) {
  subdir_path <- file.path(output_dir, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(subdir_path)) {
    dir.create(subdir_path, recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

cat("Output directory structure created at:", output_dir, "\n")
```

## Step 2: Validate Tools

```{r validate_tools}
# Check if required external tools are available
tools_to_check <- c(
  bedtools = config$tools$bedtools,
  bigWigAverageOverBed = config$tools$bigwig_average_over_bed
)

cat("Checking for required external tools...\n\n")

for (tool_name in names(tools_to_check)) {
  tool_path <- tools_to_check[tool_name]
  result <- suppressWarnings(system2("which", tool_path,
                                     stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE))

  if (length(result) == 0 || attr(result, "status") == 1) {
    cat("  [✗]", tool_name, "(", tool_path, ") - NOT FOUND\n")
    warning("Tool not found: ", tool_path,
           "\nPlease install or update path in config.yaml")
  } else {
    cat("  [✓]", tool_name, "found at:", result, "\n")
  }
}
```

## Step 3: Prepare Gene Annotations

Convert HOMER peak file to BED format and filter genes by length.

```{r prepare_genes}
prefix <- config$output$prefix
bed_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "bed_files")

# File paths
bed_filtered <- file.path(bed_dir,
                         paste0(prefix, "_genes_gt",
                               config$gene_filters$min_gene_length, "bp.bed"))

# Only run if input file exists
if (file.exists(config$input$homer_peak_file)) {
  convert_and_filter_peaks(
    config$input$homer_peak_file,
    bed_filtered,
    config$gene_filters$min_gene_length
  )

  # Preview
  preview <- read_tsv(bed_filtered,
                     col_names = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand"),
                     col_types = "ciicic", show_col_types = FALSE,
                     n_max = 5)

  cat("\nPreview of filtered genes:\n")
  print(kable(preview))

} else {
  cat("WARNING: Input HOMER peak file not found:",
      config$input$homer_peak_file, "\n")
  cat("Please update the path in config.yaml\n")
}
```

## Step 4: Generate TSR Regions

```{r generate_tsr}
tsr_for_selection <- file.path(bed_dir, paste0(prefix, "_tsr_for_selection.bed"))

if (file.exists(bed_filtered)) {
  generate_tsr_bed(
    bed_filtered,
    tsr_for_selection,
    config$tsr_parameters$upstream_extension,
    config$tsr_parameters$downstream_extension
  )

  cat("\nTSR regions generated successfully\n")
} else {
  cat("Skipping TSR generation - filtered BED file not found\n")
}
```

## Step 5: Compute Signal for Transcript Selection

```{r compute_selection_signal}
signal_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "signals")
selection_signal <- file.path(signal_dir, paste0(prefix, "_selection_signal.txt"))

if (file.exists(config$input$selection_bigwig) && file.exists(bed_filtered)) {

  compute_signal_over_bed(
    config$input$selection_bigwig,
    bed_filtered,
    selection_signal,
    config$tools$bigwig_average_over_bed
  )

  # Read and display summary
  signal_data <- read_tsv(selection_signal,
                         col_names = c("name", "size", "covered", "sum",
                                      "mean_overall", "mean_exon"),
                         col_types = "ciiddd", show_col_types = FALSE)

  cat("\nSignal statistics:\n")
  print(summary(signal_data$mean_overall))

} else {
  cat("Skipping signal computation - input files not found\n")
}
```

### Visualize Signal Distribution

```{r plot_selection_signal, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (exists("signal_data")) {

  # CDF plot
  p1 <- ggplot(signal_data, aes(x = mean_overall)) +
    stat_ecdf(geom = "point", size = 0.5, color = "#2E86AB") +
    labs(
      title = "Cumulative Distribution of Selection Signal",
      x = "Mean Signal",
      y = "Cumulative Proportion",
      caption = sprintf("n = %d regions", nrow(signal_data))
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = config$transcript_selection$signal_cutoff,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
    annotate("text",
             x = config$transcript_selection$signal_cutoff * 1.5,
             y = 0.5,
             label = sprintf("Cutoff = %.2f",
                           config$transcript_selection$signal_cutoff),
             color = "red")

  # Histogram
  p2 <- ggplot(signal_data, aes(x = mean_overall)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = config$transcript_selection$signal_cutoff,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Selection Signal",
      x = "Mean Signal",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

  print(p1)
  print(p2)

  # Save plots
  plot_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "plots")
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_selection_signal_cdf.png")),
         p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_selection_signal_hist.png")),
         p2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

## Step 6: Select Unique Transcripts

```{r select_transcripts}
unique_transcripts <- file.path(signal_dir, paste0(prefix, "_unique_transcripts.txt"))

if (file.exists(selection_signal)) {
  select_unique_transcripts(
    selection_signal,
    unique_transcripts,
    config$transcript_selection$signal_cutoff
  )

  # Display sample
  unique_data <- read_tsv(unique_transcripts,
                         col_names = c("region_name", "size", "covered",
                                      "sum", "mean_overall", "mean_exon"),
                         col_types = "ciiddd", show_col_types = FALSE)

  cat("\nTop 10 selected transcripts by signal:\n")
  top_transcripts <- unique_data %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_overall)) %>%
    head(10)

  print(kable(top_transcripts, digits = 3))
}
```

## Step 7: Extract and Filter Genes

```{r extract_genes}
bed_unique <- file.path(bed_dir, paste0(prefix, "_unique_genes.bed"))
bed_nonoverlap <- file.path(bed_dir, paste0(prefix, "_nonoverlapping_genes.bed"))

if (file.exists(unique_transcripts) && file.exists(bed_filtered)) {

  # Extract BED regions
  extract_selected_bed_regions(unique_transcripts, bed_filtered, bed_unique)

  # Remove overlapping genes
  remove_overlapping_genes(
    bed_unique,
    bed_nonoverlap,
    config$gene_filters$distance_cutoff,
    config$tools$bedtools
  )

  # Summary
  n_unique <- as.numeric(system(sprintf("wc -l < %s", bed_unique), intern = TRUE))
  n_final <- as.numeric(system(sprintf("wc -l < %s", bed_nonoverlap), intern = TRUE))

  cat(sprintf("\nFiltering summary:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  - Unique genes: %d\n", n_unique))
  cat(sprintf("  - Non-overlapping genes: %d\n", n_final))
  cat(sprintf("  - Genes removed: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
              n_unique - n_final,
              100 * (n_unique - n_final) / n_unique))
}
```

## Step 8: Generate Final TSR and Gene Body Regions

```{r generate_final_regions}
tsr_final <- file.path(bed_dir, paste0(prefix, "_tsr_final.bed"))
gb_final <- file.path(bed_dir, paste0(prefix, "_genebody_final.bed"))

if (file.exists(bed_nonoverlap)) {

  # Calculate gene body extension
  if (config$genebody_parameters$auto_calculate_extension) {
    gb_extension <- config$gene_filters$distance_cutoff / 2
    cat("Auto-calculated gene body extension:", gb_extension, "bp\n")
  } else {
    gb_extension <- config$genebody_parameters$manual_extension
    cat("Using manual gene body extension:", gb_extension, "bp\n")
  }

  # Generate regions
  generate_tsr_and_genebody_beds(
    bed_nonoverlap,
    tsr_final,
    gb_final,
    config$tsr_parameters$upstream_extension,
    config$tsr_parameters$downstream_extension,
    gb_extension
  )

  cat("\nFinal TSR and gene body regions created\n")
}
```

## Step 9: Compute Signals Over Final Regions

```{r compute_final_signals}
tsr_signal <- file.path(signal_dir, paste0(prefix, "_tsr_signal.txt"))
gb_signal <- file.path(signal_dir, paste0(prefix, "_genebody_signal.txt"))

if (file.exists(config$input$sample_bigwig) &&
    file.exists(tsr_final) && file.exists(gb_final)) {

  cat("Computing TSR signal...\n")
  compute_signal_over_bed(
    config$input$sample_bigwig,
    tsr_final,
    tsr_signal,
    config$tools$bigwig_average_over_bed
  )

  cat("\nComputing gene body signal...\n")
  compute_signal_over_bed(
    config$input$sample_bigwig,
    gb_final,
    gb_signal,
    config$tools$bigwig_average_over_bed
  )

  cat("\nSignal computation completed\n")

} else {
  cat("Skipping final signal computation - input files not found\n")
}
```

## Step 10: Compute Travel Ratio

```{r compute_tr}
tr_output <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "_travel_ratio.txt"))

if (file.exists(tsr_signal) && file.exists(gb_signal)) {

  tr_data <- compute_travel_ratio(tsr_signal, gb_signal, tr_output)

  # Display statistics
  cat("\nTravel Ratio Statistics:\n")
  print(summary(tr_data$travel_ratio))

  # Display top/bottom genes
  cat("\n### Top 10 genes by Travel Ratio (highest elongation):\n")
  top_tr <- tr_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(travel_ratio)) %>%
    arrange(desc(travel_ratio)) %>%
    head(10) %>%
    select(name, tsr_mean, gb_mean, travel_ratio)

  print(kable(top_tr, digits = 3))

  cat("\n### Bottom 10 genes by Travel Ratio (lowest elongation):\n")
  bottom_tr <- tr_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(travel_ratio)) %>%
    arrange(travel_ratio) %>%
    head(10) %>%
    select(name, tsr_mean, gb_mean, travel_ratio)

  print(kable(bottom_tr, digits = 3))

} else {
  cat("Skipping TR computation - signal files not found\n")
}
```

### Visualize Travel Ratio Distribution

```{r plot_tr, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if (exists("tr_data")) {

  # Remove NA and infinite values for plotting
  tr_plot_data <- tr_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(travel_ratio), is.finite(travel_ratio))

  # CDF plot
  p1 <- ggplot(tr_plot_data, aes(x = travel_ratio)) +
    stat_ecdf(geom = "point", size = 0.5, color = "#A23B72") +
    labs(
      title = "Cumulative Distribution of Travel Ratio",
      x = "Travel Ratio (Gene Body / TSR)",
      y = "Cumulative Proportion",
      caption = sprintf("n = %d genes", nrow(tr_plot_data))
    )

  # Histogram
  p2 <- ggplot(tr_plot_data, aes(x = travel_ratio)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(
      title = "Distribution of Travel Ratio",
      x = "Travel Ratio (Gene Body / TSR)",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

  # Density plot
  p3 <- ggplot(tr_plot_data, aes(x = travel_ratio)) +
    geom_density(fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.5, color = "#A23B72") +
    labs(
      title = "Density Plot of Travel Ratio",
      x = "Travel Ratio (Gene Body / TSR)",
      y = "Density"
    )

  # Scatter plot: TSR vs GB signal
  p4 <- ggplot(tr_plot_data, aes(x = tsr_mean, y = gb_mean)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.5, color = "#A23B72") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(
      title = "TSR vs Gene Body Signal",
      x = "TSR Mean Signal (log10)",
      y = "Gene Body Mean Signal (log10)",
      caption = "Red line: TR = 1"
    )

  # Print plots
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
  print(p3)
  print(p4)

  # Save plots
  plot_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "plots")
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_travel_ratio_cdf.png")),
         p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_travel_ratio_hist.png")),
         p2, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_travel_ratio_density.png")),
         p3, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(prefix, "_tsr_vs_gb_scatter.png")),
         p4, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}
```

# Interactive Data Exploration

If you have the DT package installed, you can explore the results interactively:

```{r interactive_table, eval=exists("tr_data")}
if (exists("tr_data") && requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {

  tr_display <- tr_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(travel_ratio)) %>%
    mutate(
      travel_ratio = round(travel_ratio, 3),
      tsr_mean = round(tsr_mean, 3),
      gb_mean = round(gb_mean, 3)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(travel_ratio))

  DT::datatable(
    tr_display,
    caption = "Travel Ratio Results - Interactive Table",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      searchHighlight = TRUE
    ),
    filter = "top"
  )
}
```

# Summary

This refactored notebook provides:

1. **Improved code organization** - Modular functions with clear responsibilities
2. **Better error handling** - Validates inputs and provides informative messages
3. **Configuration management** - All parameters in a YAML file
4. **Enhanced visualizations** - Multiple plot types for better insights
5. **Comprehensive documentation** - Clear explanations of each step
6. **Reproducibility** - Session info and parameter logging
7. **Native R implementation** - No dependency on Python or excessive bash commands

For batch processing or automated workflows, use the standalone R script:

```bash
Rscript compute_travel_ratio.R --config config.yaml
```
